name: norovo
description: Chrome extension that hides Atlassian Rovo UI.

scripts.lint: bun run lint:ext && bun run lint:js
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir=. --artifacts-dir=.web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest --ignore-files=package.json bun.lock bun.lockb node_modules/** .github/** .gitignore eslint.config.js release-please-config.json .release-please-manifest.json CHANGELOG.md README.md .web-ext-artifacts/**
